resources.string: Closes Reels, Shorts and other endless feeds, and applies your app limits, quiet hours and focus sessions.

Glance uses this service to recognise which screen is open in Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and Snapchat, so it can close the parts you chose (such as Reels, Shorts and Explore). For every other app, including TikTok, X and Reddit, it only notices which app comes to the front, by name, to apply your daily limits, quiet hours, focus sessions and the pause before opening. Everything is processed on this device; your messages, posts and screen content are never stored or sent. During a focus session or quiet hours it also watches the Settings app so that this protection cannot be switched off until they end.
